summary: The Amoebius race judge (RaceJudge.SeatOffCardHulls) seats any requested hull by name: a hull the card does not list is added to the loaded card in memory for that run, instead of the game swapping it for the card's Squirrel.
why: Regatta keeps hulls too slow to be an ally AI off its card; step 5 and their AI training still need to race them, and before this an off-card hull was silently timed as a Squirrel.
